summary: Master education recovery and knowledge transfer. Learn INEE standards, PDNA, and learning continuity. Enroll now for expert-led disaster recovery training.
lede: Post-disaster education and knowledge transfer training is for professionals restoring learning services and preserving institutional expertise. It covers assessing recovery needs, planning learning continuity across low-, high- and no-tech settings, and creating handover and institutional memory processes to retain critical knowledge when staff or infrastructure are disrupted.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is essential for professionals tasked with maintaining educational services and organizational intelligence during and after major crises.
audience: Disaster Recovery Specialists focused on social infrastructure
modules: Continuity of Learning and Digital Infrastructure
prerequisites: Participants should have at least two years of experience in education management, humanitarian response, or disaster risk reduction. Familiarity with the INEE Minimum Standards is recommended but not required. No prior coding or advanced technical skills are necessary, though basic proficiency with data entry tools is expected.
